confidence_notes: Restaurant and cafe anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Chilean price levels and are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain, since Antofagasta's mining-driven business demand can push 3-star rates above typical Chilean coastal cities. Drink anchors are estimated from general knowledge rather than checked menus. No live listings or booking pages were inspected, and no source citations are attached to the anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against mid-sized Chilean port and mining cities such as Iquique, Coquimbo/La Serena and Valparaiso, with a modest uplift for Antofagasta's mining-related hotel demand. Winter (July) pricing is assumed, with the Atacama coast's mild climate limiting any seasonal premium.
